label: Starter calculate-oee
command: python -m yotta_oee calculate-oee -i data/starter -f reports/validation_findings_starter.json -o data/starter/oee_aggregates.csv

label: Starter benchmark
command: python -m yotta_oee benchmark -i data/starter -f reports/validation_findings_starter.json -o reports/benchmark_starter.json

label: Starter export
command: python -m yotta_oee export -i data/starter -o data/starter/exports -f json,sql

label: Full calculate-oee
command: python -m yotta_oee calculate-oee -i data/full -f reports/validation_findings_full.json -o data/full/oee_aggregates.csv

label: Full benchmark
command: python -m yotta_oee benchmark -i data/full -f reports/validation_findings_full.json -o reports/benchmark_full.json

label: Full export
command: python -m yotta_oee export -i data/full -o data/full/exports -f json,sql
